verdict.rationale: Belvo's API documents link creation (with `external_id`, async and recurrent links) and retrieval of balances and transactions, and the API is accessed with API keys. Belvo also markets 'Belvo MCPs' for AI agents and offers MCP installs for Cursor and VS Code, though it is unclear whether that MCP operates links and data or only serves documentation. missing for 10: evidence of scoped or least-privilege credentials, confirmation that the MCP surface can create links and fetch financial data, documented connection-management operations (update or delete links), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the platform — create link sessions, retrieve balances and transactions, and manage connections through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Retrieve transaction history, account balances, and investment details seamlessly.
make use of the `external_id` parameter when creating links as this will allow you to have your own unique identifier for a link in your own database
